create.name: Glynis McCants
create.bio:
Glynis McCants, known as the Numbers Lady, is a numerologist based in Southern California who has studied numbers for more than two decades. She works with the Pythagorean system, in which the letters of a birth name and the digits of a birth date reduce to a handful of core numbers, above all the Life Path number. After reading many thousands of charts she wrote Glynis Has Your Number, a plain-spoken guide to working out and using your own numbers, and later Love by the Numbers, on compatibility, prompted by her own experience of choosing a partner through numerology.

She has become a familiar media numerologist, appearing on daytime and news television and as the numerology adviser to the Jim Carrey film The Number 23. Her own work is offered in an accessible, low-cost way: written individual and couple readings sent by email, an annual personal numerology calendar marking good days for action and days for caution, a home-study kit pairing her first book with an audio guide to the numbers one to nine, and live YouTube sessions where she explains the numbers and gives short readings to viewers.

books.title: Glynis Has Your Number
books.author: Glynis McCants
books.description: Her first book, a step-by-step guide to working out the core numbers in your name and birth date and reading what they say about character, timing and relationships.

books.title: Love by the Numbers
books.author: Glynis McCants
books.description: Applies her numerology system to love: which numbers tend to suit each other, which clash, and how to use that knowledge in choosing or understanding a partner.

courses.title: Individual Numerology Reading
courses.description: A written personal chart sent by email, explaining the six numbers in your chart, which numbers are compatible or challenging for you, and your best days and months.

courses.title: Soulmate Breakdown Reading
courses.description: A written compatibility report for two people, comparing their numbers to show where they match naturally and where they may meet friction.

courses.title: 2027 Numerology Calendar (PDF)
courses.description: A personalised colour calendar for the year, made from your birth date, with a symbol on each day suggesting when to act and when to hold back.

courses.title: Numerology Kit
courses.description: Her book Glynis Has Your Number together with an audio CD in which she goes through the numbers one to nine so they can be learned by heart.

free_resources.title: Discover Your Personal Numbers
free_resources.description: A free page on her site showing how to reduce your birth date to your Life Path number, with a worked example and a summary of each number's qualities.
